svg.title: Insurance & Enterprise Systems and GenAI Hub 2.0
svg.desc: A transparent 4200 by 2000 reference architecture with 64 editable modules. The left Insurance & Enterprise Systems domain uses #D6D8DA with black system and subsystem titles. The three right-side subsystems have #F6CFDA outer borders and fully opaque header bars in #E5708F, #DC416A, and #EDA0B5 from top to bottom. Their title text is #FFFFFF. The outer GenAI Hub 2.0 retains its pale #FFDEE0 frame and header. Assistant Agents and Domain Agents share white fills, black 44-point regular centered text, 4-point #DC416A strokes, and 14-point rounded corners. All original content, dimensions, and layout proportions are retained.
